verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents a built-in Quick Terminal, a lightweight terminal that animates down below the menu bar for instant access, which is a quake-style dropdown. A community user independently calls it Ghostty's 'killer feature.' Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Quick Terminal is summoned by a system-wide global hotkey (only generic keybind configuration is cited), and evidence of the dropdown on Linux (the 'menu bar' wording implies macOS).
